verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents first-party agent integration paths: an official Agents SDK for orchestration, a managed Codex harness for building agents, and Skills listed among flagship model capabilities. The evidence covers only OpenAI's own SDK and harness, so plugging the model into third-party coding agents and agent frameworks is not shown, and Skills and plugins appear only as list mentions without integration detail. Missing for 10: documented official integrations with third-party coding agents and agent frameworks, in-depth Skills and plugin documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent SDK integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support
